column1: # What enforces each requirement in this library's specs (0024-spec-format FR-011 - FR-014).

column4: result.test.ts: Result's helpers, absurd with a switch that leaves an alternative out, brands kept apart
decode.test.ts: each decoder, its error path and the JSON round trip
text.test.ts: lf, plain, splitArgs and quoteArgs, and their round trip
the type-level tests (expectType, @ts-expect-error) with their negative controls compile; the laws are property-tested with fast-check in the suite
graph.test.ts: random acyclic graphs ordered and scheduled with random outcomes and job limits, cycles, a node that rejects
objects.test.ts: compact leaves out undefined fields, its type exact under exactOptionalPropertyTypes
the package is built, inspected and packed by tools/pack.ts; tests/commons-packages.test.ts installs the tarball and runs it on Node 26 and Bun and type-checks a consumer
about.test.ts: an About value of every shape is accepted by the compiler and one with an unknown field or a missing title is refused (type-level), and the entry exports no value
